meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用增加聊天消息渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Telegram chat to your existing app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add a chat channel to your app.

howto.what: 把 Telegram 适配器、配对与格式辅助代码及其测试复制进项目并注册,安装 @chat-adapter/telegram 依赖,再引导你在 BotFather 建机器人、填入 token、重启服务,最后用 4 位配对码把你的聊天接进来。
howto.when: 当你要求给项目接入 Telegram 渠道时触发,通常发生在 /setup 流程中,或通过 /manage-channels 进入。

say.text: 帮我接入 Telegram 渠道
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并引导建 bot

say.text: 用 pair-telegram 把我的 Telegram 群配对进来
say.note: 会打印 4 位配对码等你发回机器人

say.text: 机器人收不到群里消息,怎么关 Group Privacy?

howto.what_en: Copies the Telegram adapter, its pairing/formatting helpers and tests into the project, registers the adapter, and installs @chat-adapter/telegram. Then it guides bot creation via BotFather, token storage, a restart, and a 4-digit pairing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add the Telegram channel to the project, such as during the /setup flow or via /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add the Telegram channel to my project.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the dep, guides bot setup.

say_en.text: Pair my Telegram group with pair-telegram.
say_en.note: Prints a 4-digit code to send to the bot.

say_en.text: The bot ignores group messages. How do I turn off Group Privacy?
say_en.note: Points you to BotFather's Group Privacy setting.
